legend: Pushok the dog has been chasing Imp for a few hours already.
Fortunately, Imp knows that Pushok is afraid of a robot vacuum cleaner.

While moving, the robot generates a string t consisting of letters 's' and 'h', that produces a lot of noise. We define noise of string t as the number of occurrences of string "sh" as a subsequence in it, in other words, the number of such pairs (i, j), that i < j and ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fa3acb2a51fec405fff3ffa731bf524c21b71047.png) and ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/84e6f388d5468490ab0877195de0181911c46019.png).

The robot is off at the moment. Imp knows that it has a sequence of strings ti in its memory, and he can arbitrary change their order. When the robot is started, it generates the string t as a concatenation of these strings in the given order. The noise of the resulting string equals the noise of this concatenation.
Help Imp to find the maximum noise he can achieve by changing the order of the strings.
input: The first line contains a single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 105) — the number of strings in robot's memory.
Next n lines contain the strings t1, t2, ..., tn, one per line. It is guaranteed that the strings are non-empty, contain only English letters 's' and 'h' and their total length does not exceed 105.
output: Print a single integer — the maxumum possible noise Imp can achieve by changing the order of the strings.
note: The optimal concatenation in the first sample is ssshhshhhs.

legend.ai: 狗狗 Pushok 已经追逐 Imp 几个小时了。
幸运的是，Imp 知道 Pushok 害怕扫地机器人。

移动时，机器人会生成一个由字母 ‘s’ 和 ‘h’ 组成的字符串 t，并产生大量噪音。我们将字符串 t 的噪音定义为其中字符串 "sh" 作为子序列出现的次数，换句话说，就是满足 i < j 且 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fa3acb2a51fec405fff3ffa731bf524c21b71047.png) 和 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/84e6f388d5468490ab0877195de0181911c46019.png) 的数对 (i, j) 的数量。
机器人目前处于关闭状态。Imp 知道它的内存中存储着一组字符串 ti，并且可以任意改变它们的顺序。当机器人启动时，它会按照给定顺序将这些字符串拼接成字符串 t。所得字符串的噪声等于该拼接字符串的噪声。
请帮助 Imp 找出通过改变字符串顺序所能达到的最大噪声。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 105），表示机器人内存中的字符串数量。
接下来的 n 行包含字符串 t1、t2、...、tn，每行一个。保证这些字符串非空，只包含英文字母 's' 和 'h'，且它们的总长度不超过 105。

output.ai: 输出一个整数，表示 Imp 通过改变字符串顺序所能达到的最大噪声。

note.ai: 第一个样例中的最优拼接结果为 ssshhshhhs。
